description: Insider Abuse, Dual-Control Overrides, and Anomaly Monitoring

mechanisms.rule: No single admin can approve a flagged biometric duplicate or KYC dispute; requires two independent reviewer cryptographic signatures.
Automated alarm if a reviewer's approval rate exceeds 2 sigma from team mean or processes > 30 reviews/hour.
Every biometric match decision logged with SHA-256 hash chaining to Firestore audit collection.
